definitions.explanation: The New Year celebration period in Japan, typically the first few days of January.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spend New Year's with my family.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I go back to my parents' home for New Year's.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We eat osechi ryori during New Year's.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people go for their first shrine visit during New Year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I looked forward to receiving New Year's money.

notes:
お{正月|しょうがつ} is the most important holiday period in Japan, traditionally celebrated for the first three days of January (⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧). The お- prefix is honorific; ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ is the plain form.

CULTURAL TRADITIONS:
- ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧: first shrine visit of the year
- ⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: traditional New Year foods
- ⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧: money given to children
- ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧: New Year greeting cards
- ⟦{門松|かどまつ}→門松：14522_kadomatsu⟧: pine decorations placed at entrances

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome the New Year
- お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧: New Year's mood
- お{正月|しょうがつ}⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧: New Year's holiday

USAGE:
Many businesses close from December 29 to January 3. Families typically gather at the ⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧ (parents' home) during this period.
